_note: The War Room's What's New?! board (WhatsNewDialog). `current` is this build's version (project.godot application/config/version must match; validate_data checks). Releases newest first. An item is a line of text, or {"label", "text"} for a bold lead-in, with optional "items" indented under it; {"label", "items"} with no text is a category heading (Logan, 2026-10-16: New, Gameplay, UI, Balance, Bug Fixes, each entry "Name - short description"). A release can carry a `note` {title, text, button, link}: a lit box under its version with a button that opens the link (0.2.2: the Discord is open). `next` is the What's Next?! roadmap: `updates` (kind "minor"/"major", when, items; no version number, it gets one when it ships) in planned order, then loose `items`. Text: Logan, 2026-10-14; the roadmap follows the one posted on Discord (Logan, 2026-10-15).

note.title: The Discord is open!
note.text: Come meet the other pilots, report bugs, share your builds and see what's coming next. You can join any time from the sign in the War Room.

items.label: Feedback Button
items.text: - on every screen to capture opinions and bugs, with where you are and the fight so far.

items.label: Join the Discord
items.text: - a sign in the War Room takes you straight there.

items.label: Patch Notes
items.text: - this button on the War Room's top bar opens these notes any time.

items.label: Screenshots
items.text: - F9 saves one, straight to your Steam library too.

items.label: Smarter Routes
items.text: - map paths branch more evenly, with fewer long forced stretches.

items.label: Training Mission
items.text: - rebuilt to show you around as you play:
items: A quick tour of the War Room, so you know every station there is to visit.
Map stops, heat, damage and hits are shown with the icons you'll see in game.
Reactors, hardpoints, protocols, intents and keywords each explained on the real thing.
Then play out your first turn your own way.

items.label: High Five
items.text: - counts your attacks right on its badge.

items.label: New Look
items.text: - a new font, sharper text and smoother card edges.

items.label: Card Faces
items.text: - heat sits in a flame, and damage shows as hits × damage per hit.

items.label: Enemies on the Ground
items.text: - with their health, badges, intents and name stacked above them.

items.label: Enemy Cards
items.text: - right-click an enemy part to see its cards.

items.label: Intent Source
items.text: - hovering an enemy intent also outlines the part it comes from.

items.label: Badge Row
items.text: - passives, statuses and protocols in one row, in the order they landed.

items.label: Details Box
items.text: - fits without scrolling, and hovering a part lights its share of the health bar.

items.label: Status Timers
items.text: - every status says how long it lasts.

items.label: War Table
items.text: - shorter mission briefings and quicker deployment orders.

items.label: Show Mech
items.text: - salvage opens your whole mech and Cargo.

items.label: Repair Bays
items.text: - heal at most 75 HP.

items.label: Starting Kits
items.text: - Jackal hits harder, Redline Burst a little softer.

items.label: Reroute
items.text: - can't turn a status into Disabled any more.

items.label: Protocols
items.text: - every protocol does exactly what its card says (Coordinated Strike fires again, Loaded Dice can't be parried or dodged, and more).

items.label: Replay
items.text: - says it repeats your last hardpoint card.

items.label: Enemy Overheats
items.text: - no longer look like damage to you.

items.label: Reactor Passives
items.text: - light up their part.

items.label: Settings
items.text: - fit the screen in release builds.

items.label: Crashes
items.text: - fixed a few crashes around combat and deployment orders.

items.label: Map
items.text: - stops line up with their pins and always match the route you'll get.

items.label: Defeated Enemies
items.text: - no longer keep their badges.

items.label: War Room Tour
items.text: - now shows new pilots every station.

items.label: New intro:
items.text: a new Trismeg Studios intro screen.

items.label: Training:
items.text: the training run's coaching and the reward screen were reworked.

items.label: New Art!
items: Data Archives and Mining Grounds combat backgrounds
Every event scene
12 new component portraits
War Room stations: Directives, Pilot Log, Memorial Wall, Info Bay and Livery Bay
Snow and dust weather in combat
Game icon
Trismeg Studio intro screen

items.label: Balance:
items.text: tuned some deployment orders and enemy loadouts, and enemies no longer waste their own parts.

items.label: Combat:
items.text: hover an enemy part to see its cards. Enemies with nothing left to play retreat, and status effects have their own icons.

items.label: New:
items.text: name your War Room, a new run summary, and this What's New?! board.

releases.title: First Release
items: Added another card to every hardpoint and protocol.
Balanced every card to give each one more trade-offs and you more options.
Enemies now have their own strategies and play more varied turns.
New icons for enemy intents and statuses
New achievements
New deployment orders
Fixes from your feedback

items.label: Research Runs:
items.text: a new mission type to unlock new mechs

items: More parts to unlock as you play
Steam Deck compatibility
Steam Cloud saves, so your progress follows you between PCs
Steam achievements

items.label: The Steam store page goes live:
items.text: wishlist us!

items: New events
Daily run leaderboards
New liveries

items.label: Bigger boss fights:
items.text: phases, new lines, bigger rewards

items.label: Backline Blitz:
items.text: elites and bosses only, for bigger Chip rewards

items.label: Threat levels:
items.text: optional harder modifiers for more Chips

items: More weekly directives
Balance pass

items.label: A new sector:
items.text: new location, enemies, events and battlegrounds

items: Oct 26 – Nov 8: the dev is on vacation, so no updates. Keep the feedback coming!
Week of Dec 28: holiday break, fixes only.
And much more, including your ideas!
